import re

def collapse_whitespace(s: str) -> str:
    """Collapse runs of ASCII whitespace characters into a single space and strip
    leading/trailing ASCII whitespace. All other code points, including NBSP, are
    preserved unchanged."""
    # Strip leading and trailing ASCII whitespace: space, tab, LF, CR, vertical tab, form feed
    s = s.strip(' \t\n\r\x0b\x0c')
    # Collapse any remaining runs of those characters to a single space
    return re.sub(r'[ \t\n\r\x0b\x0c]+', ' ', s)
